intro: Your change has been applied. All your features remain available, only the number of active clients changes.
overflowTitle: If you exceed the active client limit
overflowBody: You can choose which clients stay active. The others move to archives and their data remains stored.
rhythmTitle: Every stage has its own pace.
rhythmBody: FitDesk grows with you in both directions. When you want to move back up, one click is enough.
